crossRefs.note: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

translations.web: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;
translations.bsb: In my dream I also saw seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, growing on a single stalk.
translations.kjv: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
translations.asv: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good:
